title: FactoryHandoverSetup
description: The project's setup step, 'task 0': what the platform does by itself after the owner presses Hand over, before task 1 becomes startable. Fixed shape shared by Factory's hand-over status, the planner's from-brief answer and the dashboard. `steps` is ordered as `app-repo`, `hexagon-repo`, `onboard`, `register-project`, `verify-discovery`. When `localOnly` is true no remote is created and nothing is published: `app-repo` and `hexagon-repo` are `skipped`. `state` of the whole step: `pending` (no step started), `running` (a step is running or some are still pending after others are done), `done` (every step is `done` or `skipped`), `failed` (a step failed). No property carries a credential. The `setup` object of Factory's hand-over status; the planner's from-brief response embeds an identical copy in its `$defs`.

name.description: Fixed task name; a constant so Factory, the planner and the dashboard agree on it.

localOnly.description: The owner's 'Local only' choice from the hand-over request, echoed.

steps.description: Ordered; at most one entry per step id.

updatedAt.description: When the setup object last changed.

id.description: Closed set: `app-repo` creates the app repository, `hexagon-repo` the hexagon repository, `onboard` onboards the app, `register-project` registers the project, `verify-discovery` checks the platform discovers it.

state.description: `skipped` is the state of `app-repo` and `hexagon-repo` when `localOnly` is true.

reason.description: Closed short code, present when `state` is `failed`.

detail.description: Free text for the reason; never a secret.

at.description: When this step last changed state.
